entries.zh: 根深（根部扎得深、根基深固）；西语词头为残句起始“Segun…（依照…）”，全句未完
entries.en: deep-rooted, with deep foundations; the Spanish side is an unfinished clause beginning 'segun… (according to…)'
entries.notes: 词头栏 Segun ~ 与汉字释义不同属一义，释义以汉字栏“根深”为主，词头疑为未完句。

entries.zh: 稳当、保险（seguro）；弄稳、确保（asegurarse）；字面例证“担桥脚尖／落入缝口”，以桥板缺口喻步履之稳与不稳，细节存疑
entries.en: safe, secure; to secure, make sure (asegurarse); lit. illustration 'the tip of the plank on the bridge / stepping into the gap' (detail uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字第二段“落當”与音写 lò fúng（近“縫”缝口）难对合，比喻性例证仅能大意折中。

entries.zh: 酉（十二辰之酉时，约午后五至七点，当“下午六点”之属）
entries.en: six o'clock in the afternoon/evening; the you (酉) double-hour, ca. 5-7 p.m.

entries.zh: 暮（傍晚、黄昏）；词头作“自四点至六点，de la mañana 晨间”，与“暮”义相抵触
entries.en: dusk, evening; the headword reads 'from 4 to 6, of the morning', which contradicts the Chinese gloss
entries.notes: 汉字栏“暮”（傍晚）与词头“mañana（晨间）”相矛盾，释义从汉字栏，疑词头栏有讹。

entries.zh: 一年中的前六个月（依西语词头）；汉字“穩冬”与音写 ĭn fañg 无法对应，释义存疑
entries.en: the first six months of the year (per the headword); the Chinese gloss '穩冬' (in fang) cannot be resolved
entries.notes: “穩冬”两字与音写 ĭn fañg 音义均不合（“冬”不读 fang），无法定夺，释义暂从词头。

entries.zh: 封（封缄、加封）；音写兼含“封印”（hong ìn）
entries.en: to seal, seal up; to close/secure with a seal (the transcription adds hong in, 'seal with a seal')

entries.zh: 钤印记为号、加盖印记（印記号：印记、记号）
entries.en: to stamp a seal-mark (印記號: seal-mark, insignia)
to seal, to stamp, to imprint
a seal, a stamp; an imprint, seal-mark

entries.zh: 符信、符契（官府凭证之类，据音写 f̄u 推定为“符”）；汉字栏作“謁”，与词头义不合
entries.en: a tally/credential (符, inferred from the transcription fu); the Chinese gloss 謁 'calling card/visit' does not match 'seal'
entries.notes: 音写 f̄u 与“謁”(iat) 不合而近“符”(hu)，两栏相抵触，释义暂从音写推定。

entries.zh: 过印（加盖印信、钤过印记）
entries.en: stamped over with a seal; to pass under seal (過印 'pass the seal')

entries.zh: 印綬：官印与系印之绶带（官员印信）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: seal of office with its ribbon (印綬) 〔原件残缺，释义存疑 / Spanish column blank; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语栏 [空]，仅汉字与音写可据，按盲产规程标注残缺存疑。

entries.zh: 信函之封缄、护书（护住书信的封印或封皮；“护书”又指文书夹）
entries.en: the seal of the letter; lit. 護書 'protector of the letter' (護書 also: document folder/wrapper)
entries.notes: “護書”本义文书夹/护封，与词头“书信封印”的对应稍宽，取“护封书信”折中。

entries.zh: 书信之封印（同上条“护书”义）；汉字“謁書”疑为“護書”之讹，音写多出第三音 iōng（或为“用”）
entries.en: the seal of the letter (as the previous entry); the Chinese gloss 謁書 appears corrupt for 護書, with an extra third syllable iong in the transcription
entries.notes: 汉字“謁”无法对上音写 hōŭ（合“護”），栏间不合且音写多一音，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 礼拜（一星期、七天之期；亦指礼拜仪式）
entries.en: a week (seven days); also a (Christian) worship service, liturgy
